{{Quote|Only three? This might be too easy.|Sarro Xaj|<ref name="RoT" />}}
'''Sarro Xaj''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]] and was known to have had a massive physique and studied under Master [[Raskta Lsu]], and fought alongside her in the [[New Sith Wars]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. He was promoted to the rank of Jedi Knight around [[997 BBY/Legends|997 BBY]] and followed in her footsteps, training to become a [[Jedi Weapon Master]].<ref name="RoT" />

==Biography==
[[File:Duel_on_Tython.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Xaj deflects Darth Bane's Force Lightning during the Duel on Tython.]]
Xaj joined [[Raskta Lsu]], [[Worror Dowmat]], [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] and [[Johun Othone]] on the ''[[Justice Crusader]]'' to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], in pursuit of the Sith Lord [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his apprentice [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]]. Once they arrived at [[Belia Darzu]]'s castle, they immediately engaged in a [[Duel on Tython|duel]] with Darth Bane and Darth Zannah.<ref name="RoT" />

Xaj wielded a blue [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] nearly three meters long and attacked Zannah in concert with his fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Othone. However, Othone's lack of skill hindered Xaj's efforts. As Xaj pressed his offensive he was interrupted by Othone's basic strikes and was forced to pull up his attacks in order to avoid killing his companion. At one point in the battle, Farfalla called for reinforcements, and Xaj shouted for Othone to help him, leaving Xaj to duel Zannah alone. Xaj overpowered Zannah in one-on-one combat, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] channeled through him by Worror's [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. He exhausted his opponent with his superior strength and drove her back into a corner. As he moved to finish her off, Worror's concentration was broken and his battle meditation cut off, robbing Xaj of the power afforded to him by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Xaj hesitated and glanced toward his companions to see what had happened. Zannah used the opportunity to assault Xaj's mind with [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] and then [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with a blow to his chest.<ref name="RoT" />

===Legacy===
Following his death on Tython, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], alerted to the existence of Darth Bane by [[Caleb]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], sent a team of Jedi, including Masters [[Tho'natu]] and [[Obba]], to destroy him. On Ambria, in Caleb's camp, the Jedi discovered the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]] of the slain Jedi, including Xaj's. Upon the team's arrival, they were assaulted by a deranged [[Darovit]], whom they assumed to be Bane suffering from overexposure to the [[orbalisk armor]]. [[Confrontation on Ambria|Slaying him]], they deemed that the Sith were extinct, and returned the lightsaber hilts to the Temple.<ref name="RoT" />

Once returned to the Temple, the Jedi created a memorial to those Jedi who were responsible for the destruction of the Sith. All five Jedi's lightsaber hilts were set into a large white stone block in the gardens around the base of the [[Tower of First Knowledge/Legends|Tower of First Knowledge]]. Under each hilt was a depiction of its wielder, along with their name.<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Go, I can handle this one.|Xaj, to Othone|<ref name="RoT" />}}
Sarro Xaj was a massive man, standing over two meters tall and weighing 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. He had olive brown skin and a single topknot of black hair. In his youth, Xaj's passion for [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] was enough to catch the eye of [[Jedi Weapon Master|Weapons Master]] Raskta Lsu. He was confident in his abilities, humorously speculating that the upcoming battle with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] on Tython might be too easy. He even smiled at Zannah in the midst of combat once he was able to engage her in a duel alone, free of the encumbrance of Othone.<ref name="RoT" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Xaj chose to follow his master's footsteps in seeking to perfect his skills with a lightsaber. He joined his master in the [[Ruusan campaign]], and a few years after the [[New Sith Wars]], Lsu completed his training, deeming him worthy of the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Eventually he earned the rank of Weapons Master. His skill with a double-bladed lightsaber was enough to overwhelm Darth Zannah in one-on-one combat with the aid of Worror's battle meditation. Zannah described Xaj's fighting style as having more refinement than Bane's. Once the effects were cut off, he was distracted and was unable to defend himself from Zannah's Sith sorcery, resulting in his death.<ref name="RoT" />
